Headline: ConocoPhillips Joins Venture Global's Long-Term LNG Buyers
Event_Summary: ConocoPhillips has signed an agreement to purchase one million metric tons of liquefied natural gas (LNG) annually from Venture Global for 20 years, starting in 2030. This deal is part of ConocoPhillips' strategy to expand its LNG supply business, aiming for 10-15 MMtpa offtake. Venture Global continues to secure long-term contracts, recently signing an agreement with China Gas Holdings Ltd, and is progressing with its Plaquemines LNG and CP2 LNG projects.
